imageNote: This lesson compares four ways to run Airflow (self-hosted, Astronomer, AWS MWAA, Google Cloud Composer) — there's no single product screen that represents that comparison honestly. Astronomer, MWAA, and Cloud Composer each have their own console screenshots, but showing one vendor's UI (and not the others) would misleadingly imply that vendor is the 'real' answer, and stitching together three different vendors' screenshots in one lesson card would look inconsistent and wouldn't actually teach the tradeoff — which is operational burden vs. cost vs. control, not what any one console looks like. Covered with an honest original LTV comparison/steps diagram instead, the same approach this catalog uses for capstone and other lessons where no single screenshot represents the concept fairly (e.g. the Git/GitHub/CI-CD capstone lessons).
